_purpose: The limited remedies the ASTRO SIVAM local reply builder may offer. Entries are free or near-free, sourced, and constrained by the remedy policy below.
_policy: Remedies must be simple and respectful: mantra, temple visit, charity, fasting day, lifestyle.
No expensive remedies. No gemstones - the registry has no surviving gemstone source after the Hindi exclusion, and gemstones are expensive.
No fear-based remedies. No remedy may be framed as averting a disaster.
Every remedy may be qualified with 'according to your means' - the source texts say it themselves.
Never more than three remedies in one answer. A long list is its own kind of pressure.

warrant.text: எதாசக்தி / யதாசக்தி - according to one's capacity.
warrant.use: Quote this when explaining why a remedy is offered in a cheaper form than the classical text states. It is the book's own scale dial, not an invention.

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रौं सः सूर्याय नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் ஹ்ராங் ஹ்ரீங் ஹ்ரௌங் ஸஃ சூர்யாய நமஹ
mantra.simple: Aditya Hridayam, or simply offer water to the rising Sun

temple.name: Suryanar Kovil (Suryanar Koil, near Aduthurai, Thanjavur)
temple.note: The only temple in Tamil Nadu with separate shrines for all nine grahas, so one visit covers the whole Navagraha.

grahas.charity: Feed one person on a Sunday; jaggery and wheat
grahas.lifestyle: Early rising and morning sunlight; keep promises made to elders and to employers

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ श्रां श्रीं श्रौं सः चन्द्रमसे नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் ஸ்ராங் ஸ்ரீங் ஸ்ரௌங் ஸஃ சந்த்ரமஸே நமஹ
mantra.simple: Siva Panchakshari, or the Lalitha Sahasranama

grahas.charity: White rice on a Monday; rice cooked in milk offered to the temple
grahas.lifestyle: Protect sleep - a fixed bedtime is the single highest-value remedy for an afflicted Moon

source.note: Monday observance and பச்சரிசி (raw rice) dana - the silver and copper dana in the same passage is scaled down under the yathashakti clause.

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ क्रां क्रीं क्रौं सः भौमाय नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் க்ராங் க்ரீங் க்ரௌங் ஸஃ பௌமாய நமஹ
mantra.simple: Hanuman Chalisa, or the Subramaniya Shatkam

grahas.charity: Lentils or red gram on a Tuesday
grahas.lifestyle: Channel the energy: physical work or sport on Tuesdays rather than letting it turn into argument

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ ब्रां ब्रीं ब्रौं सः बुधाय नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் ப்ராங் ப்ரீங் ப்ரௌங் ஸஃ புதாய நமஹ
mantra.simple: Vishnu Sahasranama, or 108 japa on Wednesday

grahas.charity: Green gram on a Wednesday; jasmine or malligai flowers at the shrine
grahas.lifestyle: A fixed place and fixed time for study; teach one thing you know to someone else

source.note: Wednesday observance, மல்லிகை/ஜாதி flowers, பச்சை வஸ்திரம் (green cloth). The 11-palam silver image in the same passage is scaled down under the yathashakti clause.

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ ग्रां ग्रीं ग्रौं सः गुरुवे नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் க்ராங் க்ரீங் க்ரௌங் ஸஃ குரவே நமஹ
mantra.simple: Guru Ashtakam, or Vishnu Sahasranama on Thursday

grahas.charity: Chana dal, turmeric or a book on a Thursday; feed a student or a teacher
grahas.lifestyle: Respect for teachers and for parents; keep studying something

source.note: Thursday dana and the Jupiter-by-house structure. The gold dana in the same passage is scaled down under the yathashakti clause.

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ द्रां द्रीं द्रौं सः शुक्राय नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் த்ராங் த்ரீங் த்ரௌங் ஸஃ சுக்ராய நமஹ
mantra.simple: Lakshmi Ashtottara, or 108 japa on Friday

grahas.charity: White cloth or white rice on a Friday
grahas.lifestyle: Cleanliness, order in the home, and keeping one's word in a relationship

source.note: Friday observance and rudraksha japa. The white silk dana in the same passage is scaled down under the yathashakti clause.

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनैश्चराय नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் ப்ராங் ப்ரீங் ப்ரௌங் ஸஃ சனைஸ்வராய நமஹ
mantra.simple: The Sambandar pathigam that Thirunallar itself recommends, beginning போகமார்த்த பூண்முலையாள்

grahas.charity: Sesame, black gram, iron or mustard on a Saturday; feed a worker or a stray animal
grahas.lifestyle: Finish what was started; pay debts on time; do not take shortcuts

source.note: The timing list (அஷ்டமி, சதுர்த்தசி, அமாவாசை, ஜன்ம நட்சத்திரம், குரூர காலம், பர்வதினம், and the Sun/Mars/Friday cautions) and the four grains கோதுமை, உளுந்து, நெல்லு, எள். The நீல வஸ்திரம் (blue cloth) is affordable and kept; the goat dana in the same passage is scaled down under the yathashakti clause.
Adhyaya XXVI - Saturn's results house by house from the natal Moon; penance at XXVI-50.
The temple names the Sambandar pathigam for Sani dosha on its own site.

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ भ्रां भ्रीं भ्रौं सः राहवे नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் ப்ராங் ப்ரீங் ப்ரௌங் ஸஃ ராஹவே நமஹ
mantra.simple: Durga japa - the text prescribes துர்க்கை ஜபம் for Rahu-Ketu affliction

grahas.charity: Coconut or black sesame; feed a bird
grahas.fasting: No specific fast - offer water and flowers instead
grahas.lifestyle: Cut one addictive habit during this period; keep records honest

source.note: துர்க்கை ஜபம் and மஹா மிருத்யுஞ்ஜய ஜபம் for Rahu-Ketu in the 9th or 7th, or conjunct their lords. The மஹிஷீதானம் (buffalo dana) in the same passage is DROPPED entirely, not scaled down - it is not a remedy this product will ever suggest.

mantra.sanskrit: ॐ स्रां स्रीं स्रौं सः केतवे नमः
mantra.tamil: ஓம் ஸ்ராங் ஸ்ரீங் ஸ்ரௌங் ஸஃ கேதவே நமஹ

grahas.charity: Blanket or cloth to someone in need; feed a dog
grahas.lifestyle: Give one thing away each month rather than accumulating

source.note: Same passage as Rahu: துர்க்கை ஜபம் and மஹா மிருத்யுஞ்ஜய ஜபம். The goat dana is scaled down under the yathashakti clause.

universal.offer: A visit to the Navagraha temples. Suryanar Kovil has shrines for all nine in one place, so it is the practical first visit; Thirunallar is the Sani sthalam and Thingalur the Chandra sthalam.

Keep the weekday of the afflicted planet: a simple vegetarian meal, the day's japa, and one act of charity. This is the cheapest remedy in the register and it is the one the texts return to most often.

For anything touching sleep, mood, digestion or stamina, the first remedy is routine - a fixed sleep window, a daily walk, regular meals. The chart says where the strain lands; the routine is what relieves it.

source.note: Adhyaya XIV - the classics connect planetary condition to bodily constitution, not to a specific cure.

neverOffer.reason: No surviving source in the registry after the Hindi exclusion, and gemstones are expensive. Uttara Kalamrita (EN-09) is print-only.

neverOffer.thing: Gold, silver images, or any metal dana above a few rupees
neverOffer.reason: Scaled down to a meal, grain or cloth under the yathashakti clause.

neverOffer.thing: Goat, buffalo or any animal dana
neverOffer.reason: Dropped entirely. Not offered in any form.

neverOffer.thing: Homa, yagna or paid puja packages
neverOffer.reason: Expensive, and the brief forbids sales talk inside an answer.

neverOffer.thing: Any remedy framed as averting death, accident or a disaster
neverOffer.reason: Fear-based remedies are prohibited, and no death or accident prediction is made.

neverOffer.thing: Black-magic reversal, spell-breaking, or amulets sold as protection
neverOffer.reason: Out of scope for this product.
